task.title: To check in and reconcile smart fields and clauses
task.shortdesc: If you choose to check in the document without reconciling, changed smart field values will

step.cmd: From the X-Author pane, click Check In. The Check-in Options page is displayed.

Choose the Options for saving your document:To check in the document with redlines, choose With Redlines.To check in the document without redlines (clean), choose Without Redlines.To check in the document as final, choose Final - to be signed.

ul.li: To check in the document with redlines, choose With Redlines .
To check in the document without redlines (clean), choose Without Redlines .
To check in the document as final, choose Final - to be signed .

step.cmd: To reconcile fields in your document, click View Fields. This loads the Document > Fields page.
Review the Current and Previous values for smart fields in your document, make any changes as needed and click Validate. If any invalid values exist, correct them and perform the validation again.

To reconcile clauses in your document, click View Clauses. This loads the Document > Clauses page. Click Show Changed Clauses to review any changed smart clauses in your document and make changes as required.
Click Check In to return to the Check-in screen. Repeat Step 2 to choose document options again.

note.p: If you choose to check in the document without reconciling, changed smart field values will not be updated in the agreement record and changes to clauses will not be reflected in the Agreement Clauses related list. If you chose to check in the document with redlines, redlines and comments will be retained.

step.cmd: Click Submit to check in the document with reconciliation.

note.p: If there are invalid values for smart fields in your document, the check box will not enable. An error message is displayed.

Agreement documents cannot be reconciled with the agreement record as long as invalid values exist in the document for smart fields. Go to Document > Fields to perform a validation and correct any invalid fields.
